# scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile_list (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Retrieves a list of DLP Data Filtering Profiles (`GET /v2/api/data-filtering-profiles`), optionally filtered by name or status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List DLP data filtering profiles, optionally filtered by name.
data "scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile_list" "all" {}

data "scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile_list" "by_name" {
  name = "REPLACE_WITH_NAME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Optional filtering profile name filter.
- `status` (String) Optional status filter.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of matching data filtering profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `total` (Number) Total number of filtering profiles returned.

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data filtering profile.
- `is_end_user_coaching_enabled` (Boolean) Whether End User Coaching is enabled.
